name: Bahnsen Knights
source:
Bahnsen Knights is a work of interactive pulp fiction set in a world of religious fanatics, f5 tornadoes and Ford Sierras. Go undercover as Boulder, an agent infiltrating a religious cult performing ‘route exorcisms’ while a string of biblical storms rips across the county.

The Bahnsen Knights’ highest authority, Toni, is an ex-car salesman preaching that Hell is not below but above us all. He was being investigated by agent Cupra, one of your oldest friends in the organization. But now Cupra’s gone. Does Toni have something to do with his disappearance? And what about the Bahnsen Knights? What are they trying to achieve? And why are they holding paranormal investigator Lou Hill captive in a trunk?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933190/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Bahnsen Knights》是一部互动通俗小说，故事设定在宗教狂热分子、F5级龙卷风和福特Sierra并存的世界。你将化名Boulder，卧底潜入一个邪教组织。该组织进行所谓的“公路驱魔”，与此同时，一连串圣经中的风暴正横扫整个县。

Bahnsen Knights的最高权威Toni曾是汽车推销员，如今宣扬地狱不在地下，而是在我们头顶。组织里最老的朋友、探员Cupra曾负责调查他，但如今Cupra失踪了。Toni与她的消失有关吗？Bahnsen Knights又在谋划什么？他们为何把超自然调查员Lou Hill关在后备箱里？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933190/]Steam[/url]]
